XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Front assist malfunction, with generic fault warning light illuminated.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ADAS | ADJUSTMENT | RADAR | FRONT | HELP | FRONT | YELLOW | YELLOW | TRIANGLE | LIGHTS UP | LIGHTED | DANGER | GENERIC | C1103 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: ADAS

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: The vehicle’s Front Assist system is not functioning, and the generic fault warning light is illuminated.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: C1103 (Position fault – Automatic distance control sensor)

  • Cause: Inadequate front radar adjustment

• Action: Carry out the adjustment using diagnostic equipment

  • Procedure:

  • Note: In this case, to rectify the fault, the front radar was adjusted using diagnostic equipment.
